params.caption: 🖥️ Doom now runs on a USB flash drive's tiny screen Hacker Aaron Christophel ported Doom to the built-in LCD of a MOVESPEED MSSU10 flash drive. He dumped the firmware from a chip with scrubbed markings through an open debug port, got the game running with AI help, and you play it by copying files to the drive. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 13:30 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @bethesda 🤯 React if this is peak Doom · 💬 What device should run it next? #Doom #RetroGaming #Hardware #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
